name.hr: Lažna Hrvatska pošta: paket ne može biti dostavljen, ažurirajte adresu
name.en: Fake Croatian Post: parcel can’t be delivered, update your address

how.hr: SMS u ime Hrvatske pošte javlja da paket ne može biti isporučen zbog netočne adrese ili podataka koji nedostaju. Poveznica traži „ažuriranje“ ili malu doplatu za dostavu, a na kraju broj kartice i CVC/CVV. Poruka često stiže upravo dok čekate paket, ali to je slučajnost.
how.en: A text in the name of Croatian Post says a parcel can’t be delivered because of a wrong address or missing details. The link asks you to “update” them or pay a small delivery fee, and finally asks for your card number and CVC/CVV. It often arrives just as you’re expecting a parcel, but that is a coincidence.

text.en: A “Post” text: a parcel is waiting, something is missing.

text.hr: Poveznica na stranicu koja nije na službenoj domeni pošte.
text.en: A link to a page that isn’t on the Post’s official domain.

text.hr: Treba ažurirati adresu ili platiti sitnu doplatu.
text.en: You must update the address or pay a small fee.
They ask for your card number and CVV.

text.hr: Hrvatska posta: Vasa posiljka je zadrzana u sortirnom centru jer adresa nije potpuna. Molimo dopunite podatke unutar 12 sati, inace ce posiljka biti vracena posiljatelju [poveznica]
text.en: Croatian Post: Your shipment is held at the sorting centre because the address is incomplete. Please complete the details within 12 hours, otherwise it will be returned to the sender [link]

en: croatian post text about parcel address
delivery fee text asks for card
parcel will be returned to sender text

hr: Hrvatska pošta SMS-om ne traži dodatno plaćanje ni podatke kartice.
Službene obavijesti imaju broj pošiljke koji možete provjeriti sami u praćenju pošiljaka.
Gramatičke greške, tekst bez dijakritika ili na engleskom i čudna adresa znakovi su prijevare.
en: Croatian Post doesn’t ask for extra payment or card details by text.
Official notices carry a tracking number you can check yourself in parcel tracking.
Grammar mistakes, text without Croatian letters or in English, and an odd address are signs of fraud.

hr: Ignorirajte poruku i ne otvarajte poveznicu.
Status pošiljke provjerite sami na službenoj stranici za praćenje.
Ako ste upisali karticu, odmah nazovite banku.
en: Ignore the message and don’t open the link.
Check the parcel yourself on the official tracking page.
If you entered your card, call your bank at once.

sources.title: HP upozorava na prevaru: Ignorirajte lažne SMS poruke o nemogućnosti dostave paketa
